positioning.qgis_track: small-scale, high-quality LANDING capability validation: correct QGIS operators, operator composition, data flow, executability in QGIS Processing / PyQGIS
positioning.gee_track: large-scale GENERAL planning capability validation: complex GIS task understanding, L3 sequence generation, long chains, multi-step composition, temporal / remote-sensing tasks (GEE-sourced gold)
positioning.training_mirror: GEE teaches general GIS workflow ability; QGIS teaches QGIS grounding; both map to the shared L3 taxonomy
positioning.scoring_model: one unified scoring: L3-planning score (GEE-sourced gold) + QGIS-landing score (QGIS-sourced gold) -> overall score; M1/M2/M3 comparison happens on this combined frame

consequences: The QGIS benchmark does NOT carry full workflow-capability coverage: its structural quotas (branch, merge, length, modality) are TARGET GAPS, and an honest quota_shortfall is always preferred over forced filling

L4 (expert-authored structural fill for pure_branch) is CLOSED: even if pure_branch lands at 3-5 of the 8 target, the shortfall is recorded per roster rule R1 rather than repaired with non-source structures
The frozen budget matrix (449ef0b) is NOT modified by this decision; its floors remain the declared targets, and realized shortfalls are reported explicitly in the v0.2 audit
L3 branch semantics stays deferred and low-stakes: both has_fanout and pure_branch counts are reported; neither drives admission

The GEE planning benchmark is a FUTURE workstream: GEE-sourced gold does not exist yet (paper_v1 holds 8,283 GEE training rows only); its governance, gold derivation, and scorer integration will be specced separately -- nothing in the current v0.2 pipeline starts it
immediate_applications: The 24-entry dual review concludes on authenticity, not on quota arithmetic
The 1 dual_reject (cartogram wrapper) stands excluded regardless of any supply pressure
Disagreement adjudication below prioritizes source fidelity over structure counts
